def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Temporary qubits for carries
    c = ctx.alloc(3)  # carry bits c0, c1, c2
    t = ctx.alloc(1)  # temporary
    
    # Initialize carries to 0 (they are already 0)
    
    # Compute carries using Toffoli gates
    # c0 = a0 & b0
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
    
    # c1 = (a1 & b1) XOR (a1 & c0) XOR (b1 & c0)
    # Use temporary t
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t[0])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], c[2])
    # Now c[1] = a1 & c0, c[2] = b1 & c0
    # Need to XOR t into c[1] and c[2]? Actually we need c1 = majority(a1,b1,c0)
    # Standard: c1 = (a1&b1) ^ (a1&c0) ^ (b1&c0)
    # We have t = a1&b1, c[1] = a1&c0, c[2] = b1&c0
    # XOR them into c[1]
    ctx.cx(t[0], c[1])
    ctx.cx(c[2], c[1])
    # Now c[1] = majority, but we used c[2] as temp - need to clean it
    # Clean c[2] by uncomputing b1&c0
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], c[2])
    # Clean t
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t[0])
    
    # Now c[0] = a0&b0, c[1] = majority(a1,b1,c0)
    # Compute c2 = majority(a2,b2,c1)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], t[0])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], c[0])  # reuse c[0] as temp? No, need c[0] later
    # Better: use another temp - we have c[0] used, c[1] used, c[2] used
    # Let's use a fresh temp
    t2 = ctx.alloc(1)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], t2[0])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], t2[0])  # t2 now = b2&c1
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[2])
    # Now c[2] = majority(a2,b2,c1)
    # Clean t2
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], t2[0])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], t2[0])
    ctx.free(t2)
    
    # Now we have carries: c[0]=a0&b0, c[1]=majority(a1,b1,c0), c[2]=majority(a2,b2,c1)
    
    # Compute sum bits: s_i = a_i ^ b_i ^ c_{i-1} (with c_{-1}=0)
    # For i=0: s0 = a0 ^ b0
    ctx.cx(b[0], a[0])
    # For i=1: s1 = a1 ^ b1 ^ c0
    ctx.cx(b[1], a[1])
    ctx.cx(c[0], a[1])
    # For i=2: s2 = a2 ^ b2 ^ c1
    ctx.cx(b[2], a[2])
    ctx.cx(c[1], a[2])
    
    # Now a holds the sum, b unchanged
    
    # Clean up carries: uncompute c[2], c[1], c[0]
    # Uncompute c[2] = majority(a2,b2,c1)
    # We need to reverse the computation of c[2]
    # We have a2,b2,c1 unchanged, and c[2] is the majority
    # To uncompute: apply same Toffolis in reverse order
    # But we used t2 which is freed - need to recompute t2? 
    # Simpler: use the fact that c[2] = majority(a2,b2,c1)
    # We can uncompute by: 
    #   t2 = a2&b2, then c[2] ^= t2, then c[2] ^= (a2&c1), then c[2] ^= (b2&c1)
    # But we need to be careful with order.
    # Let's just recompute t2 and undo.
    t2 = ctx.alloc(1)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], t2[0])
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[2])  # remove a2&b2 contribution
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], t2[0])  # t2 = a2&c1
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[2])  # remove a2&c1 contribution
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], t2[0])  # uncompute t2
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], t2[0])  # t2 = b2&c1
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[2])  # remove b2&c1 contribution
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], t2[0])  # uncompute t2
    ctx.free(t2)
    # Now c[2] should be 0
    
    # Uncompute c[1] = majority(a1,b1,c0)
    t2 = ctx.alloc(1)
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], t2[0])
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c[0], t2[0])
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c[0], t2[0])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], t2[0])
    ctx.cx(t2[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], t2[0])
    ctx.free(t2)
    
    # Uncompute c[0] = a0&b0
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
    
    # Free all temporaries
    ctx.free(c[0])
    ctx.free(c[1])
    ctx.free(c[2])
    ctx.free(t[0])

def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(3); ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(3); ctx.reg("b", b)
    c = ctx.alloc()                 # single carry ancilla, |0>

    def maj(i):
        # (a[i], b[i], c) -> (a^b, b^c, carry_out)
        ctx.cx(b[i], a[i])
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)

    def uma(i):
        # (a^b, b^c, carry_out) -> (sum, b, carry_in)
        ctx.ccx(a[i], b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(b[i], c)
        ctx.cx(c, b[i])
        ctx.cx(c, a[i])

    for i in range(3):           # forward: propagate carries LSB->MSB
        maj(i)
    for i in range(3 - 1, -1, -1):   # backward: uncompute carries MSB->LSB
        uma(i)

    ctx.free(c)
